## Practical Reading Order
1. Read the overview to confirm Pages limitations and URL structure.
2. Read the site creation guide to choose branch deploy or Actions.
3. Read the custom domain guide only if DNS or HTTPS setup is required.
4. Read the Jekyll guide only if the repository intentionally uses Jekyll.
